messages.subject: Customize new functions in Wallace
messages.body_plain:
Hi there!

I am a novice and unfamiliar with Shiny modules and now I am tasked to add a new Kernel Density Estimation (kde2d) function into the ProcEnv workflow in the "multisp" branch.

May I know where can I find a file equivalent to functions.R in multisp? I am trying to find where can I edit and add a new function but have failed so far.

Hope you can point me to the right direction or a reading material on how to customize Wallace for beginners.

Thank you very very much!
Chen

messages.subject: Re: Customize new functions in Wallace
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

For the dev version on the multisp branch you would have to add your function in the R folder and also the shiny implementation separately. We have two draft vignettes on how to add modules, I am copying the links here. Let us know if you need any help.

New module vignette : https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace/blob/multiSp/vignettes/newModVignette.Rmd
New module vignette : https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace/blob/multiSp/vignettes/wallace-module-authorship-v2.Rmd

Best,
Andrea

Andrea Paz
PhD candidate
Biology program, Graduate Center
City University of New York
https://andrepazv.github.io

messages.subject: Re: Module 4, cannot specify study region
messages.body_plain:
Hi Francisca,

For this module you must upload a csv file with 2 columns (longitude and latitude) specifying the vertices of your polygon. In this case you would have two columns and four rows one for each vertex .

Best,

Andrea

Andrea Paz
PhD candidate
Biology program, Graduate Center
City University of New York

messages.subject: Creating new environmental layer for a small study area for SDM using maxent
messages.subject_clean: Creating new environmental layer for a small study area for SDM using maxent
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
I would like to know how to create new environmental data layers (like soil pH, soil humidity and soil temperature) using data sets in spreadsheet/.csv format for Species Distribution Modelling using Maxent. The study area is as small as a district/county. I am open to alternative methods, if any.
I request your suggestions.
                                                                                                                             Thank you
